title: Selective Reasoning for Typed Decision Models: When to Start, Read, and Stop
abstract: arXiv:2610.19644v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typed decision models need an interface that can use additional reasoning while retaining candidate outputs. We train a shared candidate-answer reader on a frozen Qwen3.5-4B backbone to unify direct decisions with on-demand, interruptible reasoning. The reader returns distributions from empty and partial reasoning prefixes. A benefit gate starts reasoning, a natural-state trigger requests explicit reads, and an entropy rule accepts acquired answers and cancels generation. Measurements distinguish answer-query work, generated output, and pipeline time. Across 768 questions from ProofWriter, LogiQA 2.0, and ARC-Challenge, accuracy rises from 70.96% for direct reading to 84.38%. Relative to 512-token terminal reading, accuracy improves by 7.29 percentage points with 2.25% more mean output work. Relative to 1,024-token terminal reading, pipeline time falls by 46.30% with an accuracy difference of -1.17 points. Exact-prefix controls isolate t

translated_title: 类型化决策模型的选择性推理：何时开始、何时读取、何时停止
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型需要一个既能利用额外推理、又能保留候选输出的接口。我们在冻结的 Qwen3.5-4B 骨干模型上训练了一个共享的候选答案读取器，将直接决策与按需、可中断的推理统一起来。该读取器从空推理前缀和部分推理前缀中返回分布。一个收益门控决定何时启动推理，一个自然状态触发器请求显式读取，一条熵规则在接受已获得的答案后取消生成。测量指标区分了答案查询工作量、生成输出和流水线时间。在来自 ProofWriter、LogiQA 2.0 和 ARC-Challenge 的 768 个问题上，准确率从直接读取的 70.96% 提升至 84.38%。相对于 512 token 的终端读取，准确率提高了 7.29 个百分点，而平均输出工作量仅增加 2.25%。相对于 1,024 token 的终端读取，流水线时间减少了 46.30%，准确率差异为 -1.17 个百分点。精确前缀对照实验隔离了……
tldr: 该论文在冻结骨干模型上训练共享候选答案读取器，通过收益门控启动推理、自然状态触发器显式读取、熵规则停止生成，实现按需可中断的选择性推理，将决策准确率从 70.96% 提升至 84.38%，同时相比终端读取最多减少 46.30% 的流水线时间。
en_tdlr: This paper trains a shared candidate-answer reader on a frozen backbone that selectively starts reasoning via a benefit gate, performs explicit reads via a natural-state trigger, and stops via an entropy rule, boosting accuracy from 70.96% to 84.38% while reducing pipeline time by up to 46.30% compared to terminal reading.
